Name: Sheba, Son of Bichri
Summary: Sheba, son of Bichri, a Benjamite, blew a trumpet after Absalom's fall and cried that Israel had no part in David, drawing the northern tribes into revolt. Joab besieged him at Abel, and a wise woman of the city had his head thrown over the wall to end the siege.
KeyStory: Sheba's trumpet called Israel away from David — and a wise woman's bargain ended him at Abel.
LifeLesson: A trumpet blown in bitterness can summon a rebellion — and a city can buy peace with one head.
